name: RxNorm
tagline: NLM drug nomenclature API for names, ingredients, and relationships
description: RxNorm is the U.S. National Library of Medicine API for normalized drug names, ingredients, and related clinical drug concepts used in healthcare systems.

auth.details: No auth for ordinary public REST endpoints. Exception: getProprietaryInformation may require a UMLS UTS API key via Authorization: Bearer for restricted source vocabularies.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free of charge; online usage limited to 20 requests/second per IP address. No paid plan is offered.

rate_limits: Maximum 20 requests/second per IP address; excess requests may not be serviced. NLM recommends caching results for 12–24 hours.
use_cases: resolve a drug brand name to an RxCUI
list ingredients for a clinical drug
find related drug concepts by relationship type
search RxNorm for approximate name matches
get NDCs associated with an RxCUI
